chronological_fold_design.candidate_clock: feature source time <= generation start <= generation completion <= freeze commit <= persist acknowledgement < original candidate cutoff.
chronological_fold_design.design: One fixed real-time Grade-R engineering card after synthetic-only parser preparation and a distinct run approval; there is no fitting, fold selection, backtest, ROI, or model comparison.
chronological_fold_design.history_clock: Only the newest DI history row with normalized source date strictly less than 2026-08-08 may populate previous-race features.
chronological_fold_design.late_race_rule: A race whose original cutoff has passed before persistence is retained as deterministic no-bet and is never backfilled.
chronological_fold_design.quote_clock: Frozen candidate first; then exact-pair quote handling under the unchanged strict contract.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real DI parsing output, inference, quote, result, payout, or ROI operation is allowed during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE. The exact real-data command runs once only after a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant and remains attached to an execution channel with a timeout exceeding 360 minutes.

data_as_of: EXP022 passed 94/94 exact tests and completed full DI import for 36 races and 462 runners: 420 experienced runners mapped, 42 explicit no-history runners, latest history 2026-08-02, and zero history contract failures. Its exact real-data process outlived a 14-second orchestration channel timeout, then terminated after Sapporo baseline output when the inherited output channel had closed. It produced no candidate, quote, result, ROI, BUY, order, notification, or stake artifact and was marked INVALID.
hypothesis: The audited EXP022 dual-date implementation and unchanged frozen card pipeline are sufficient; keeping the exact real-data command attached to a long-lived orchestration channel will allow all 36 targets to reach deterministic terminal records without any prediction-policy change.
in_scope: After a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant, execute the unchanged fixed 36-race Grade-R command once through an attached orchestration channel whose timeout exceeds the proposal wall-clock budget
Create EXP023 identity-only config and target manifests while preserving every prediction and safety setting from EXP022
Keep all 36 race identities, 462 runners, source inputs, model artifacts, candidate policy, confidence policy, and source-time contracts fixed
Keep formal_buy false, send_order false, stake zero, dashboard mutation false, notification false, credential access false, and order imports disabled
Run the unchanged exact 94-test command after APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
lineage_hash_requirements: Each experienced runner maps exactly one newest prior row; each no-history runner is explicit and still receives all 24 schema columns
Each mapped history row comes from the same fixed DI horse block and has a normalized race date strictly before 2026-08-08
Every Top3-set and derived WIDE distribution passes mass, finite, range, support, and duplicate checks
Every candidate-ready row is persisted before its original cutoff; every late or unsupported row fails closed
Every output sets candidate_uses_odds false, formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero
Every present DI date alias on a selected history row normalizes to the same strict pre-target YYYYMMDD date
Horse name and blood-registration identity are checked whenever both the current DU identity and history row identity are available
The source HTM, DU, DR, three target manifests, fold manifest, inference bundle, feature schema, model artifact, and history inputs remain hash-bound
The three EXP019 compatibility manifests exactly match their archived SHA-256 values and are used only by synthetic backward-compatibility tests
null_hypothesis: The exact tests or fixed card command still fails when the orchestration channel remains attached, any target lacks a terminal record, or any code, model, feature, threshold, candidate, market, or production change is required.
out_of_scope: Any alternative pair, ticket type, race, or stake search after observing a quote
Any current-day result, target-race result, final odds, payout, ROI, or post-race information before outcome joining
Any historical backtest, outer OOS comparison, ROI calculation, or action-policy optimization
Any new predictive feature, feature transformation, imputation policy, model training, refit, calibration change, confidence threshold change, value threshold search, or candidate reranking
Any odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, or derivative in candidate generation, ranking, confidence, tie-break, or abstention
Any production dashboard mutation, notification, credential, purchase adapter, TARGET handoff, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order transmission
Any retrospective candidate freeze, missed-cutoff repair, or promotion of an expired race
Any support for obstacle races or domains outside flat turf and flat dirt

primary_metric.baseline: EXP022 proved the complete 36-race/462-runner DI import contract but stopped after Sapporo baseline output because its inherited orchestration output channel had closed.
primary_metric.evaluation: All 94 exact tests pass; all 24 prior-race columns exist for 462 rows; 420 experienced runners map one pre-target row; 42 no-history runners remain explicit; and all 36 fixed targets reach deterministic terminal records under the unchanged pipeline.
primary_metric.name: candidate_terminal_completeness_after_attached_execution

purge_embargo.history_cutoff: No row dated 2026-08-08 or later may enter target features.
purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, or derivative may influence candidate selection, confidence, tie-break, or abstention.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No missed candidate cutoff or strict quote cutoff may be repaired with later information.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: All 36 race identities and 462 runners remain fixed independently of market and results.

racing_mechanism: The frozen model requires each runner's latest historical performance context. DI260808 contains those pre-race observations inside each horse block, but the multicard adapter currently retains only the current runner identity and discards the history table. This experiment restores existing model inputs without changing their definitions or the model policy.

rejection_gate: Any current-day result, odds, popularity, market, payout, ROI, dashboard, notification, credential, BUY, or order side effect reaches candidate generation
